visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with long brown hair and soft bangs is featured in a warm, brightly lit studio setting. She is positioned in a close-up shot, smiling radiantly while touching her right cheek with well-manicured fingers. She is dressed in a delicate white sleeveless top and wears a gold bracelet and multiple small earrings. The background consists of elegantly draped white fabric, and the edge of a gold-rimmed circular mirror is visible in the foreground. (2) The scene transitions to a technical display of skincare products. Three sets of 'AQUAMAX' brand bottles, categorized into series like 'Repairing' and 'Firming,' are neatly arranged. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese provide product names and benefits. A laboratory beaker is seen in the background, suggesting a scientifically formulated approach to beauty. (3) The woman is shown applying various liquids to her face. She demonstrates the application of a toner using a cotton pad, followed by serums from 'red' and 'black' bottles. Close-ups focus on the textures of the products and the woman's glowing, well-hydrated skin as she massages her face with gentle circular motions. (4) Detailed infographics appear on screen under the heading 'Clinical Trial Results.' They feature microscopic skin surface comparisons from 7 to 14 days, highlighting improvements in pore size and skin texture. The woman occasionally reappears to point at specific bottles, emphasizing the targeted benefits of each serum. (5) The final sequence shows the woman applying a facial sheet mask. She is seen unfolding the wet white mask and carefully smoothing it over her face. After removal, she presents her clear, radiant complexion. The video ends with a collective shot of the entire product line against a silk background, followed by an animated brand logo for 'AQUAMAX.'
